title: Make authority, delegation, review ownership, and waivers machine-inspectable
desired_change: Create an authority repository manifest covering actor roles, object/operation scopes, environments, risk classes, allow/deny/hold/escalate outcomes, delegation, co-approval, expiration, emergency authority, waiver rules, CODEOWNERS, and PR review requirements.
expected_outcome: Every approval path can be reconstructed and tested without assuming Bryan is present or that repository write access equals semantic authority.

risk.rights_or_safety_impact: Implicit authority can permit unauthorized canon, rights-sensitive changes, or unreviewed waivers.

hidden_context_dependencies: The docs list authority modes but define no authority IDs, owners, or resolution algorithm.
The owner field says Quirk Core but does not identify the accountable human or delegated role.
No rule explains who may approve a Golden release, a waiver, a forgetting action, or a provider mutation.
GitHub repository permission is not distinguished from Quirk semantic authority.
No CODEOWNERS or review matrix exists.
acceptance_checks: Every L2–L5 sample resolves to allow, deny, hold, or escalate.
No agent can self-promote its proposal.
Waivers require a receipt and cannot waive non-waivable gates.
Repository permission alone never satisfies semantic authority.
